title: Replicated health
summary: Damage checks authority, then OnRep hears the replicated health.
when_to_use: Use this when health should change on the server and the UI should hear OnRep.
common_mistakes: A common mistake is to subtract health on the client, or to replicate the widget.

nodes.note: Any Damage is the request. Authority decides.
Has Authority keeps the change on the server.
A stand-in for health after the hit.
OnRep runs on the clients that hear the property.
The UI listens. It does not decide the number.
